title: The Master issues a reporter identity for another install on its host from its own session
description: Two installs on one host, each with its own temporary Postgres control plane. From install A's master session, launched under its real confinement the way the loop launches it, `master peer issue --root B` mints a reporter identity through A's control plane and places the token file under B's config directory with mode 0600; a session launched before the peer was recorded records the peer and names the rerun, and the rerun from a relaunched session places the token. B's master issues its side the same way, each master peer list names the other, and B's master send reaches A through Graphyard authenticated as the identity A's confined session issued.

steps.name: A confined Master session issues B its reporter identity; both sides peer and B's send reaches A
